decisions.reason: The assembly-wide component availability check does not alter the connector specification or its existing sourceability and fallback constraints.
Checking component availability for an assembled order does not change any battery-protection behavior or thresholds.
The source decision does not change board dimensions, orientation, mounting, connector placement, or other mechanical-layout constraints.
The assembly component availability check does not modify the charge-status indicator, GPIO, or separate-LED requirement.
The source decision does not change the battery connector's family, pinout, mounting style, orientation, or placement.
The availability check does not alter the boost converter's enable control, pull-down, powered loads, or operation mode.
The source decision does not change the interboard connector architecture, connector types, signals, or pinouts.
Although assembly is discussed, the component availability check does not change the already selected eight-layer stack.
The source decision does not alter I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
